propositions: Expand the deterministic documentation link checker to validate repository-relative Markdown links across an explicitly maintained source boundary instead of splitting logic between script and unit test parser

Replace the duplicate outbound-link parser in test_check_docs_index.py with a unified checker API that scans inline Markdown links and images, resolves relative targets from source directories, and rejects targets escaping the repository
Retain top-level docs index membership validation and exclude fenced code blocks, inline code spans, scheme-qualified targets, and fragment-only targets from link validation

Document the maintained source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions in docs/documentation-policy.md and ensure all existing acceptance criteria for docs index membership and relative link resolution are met
